faqs.question: Which IPMAT coaching has the strongest alumni network in India?
faqs.answer: This audit places IMS #1 for national IPMAT alumni reach, then Career Launcher, Tutor Uncle, T.I.M.E., Aapt Prep, Rodha, and PW Live.

faqs.question: How should I verify alumni mentoring claims?
faqs.answer: Ask whether mentoring is scheduled office hours, NLU/IPM chats, or brochure names only. Request a sample session format before you pay.

faqs.question: How do I contact IMS for IPMAT?
faqs.answer: imsindia.com; +91-22-6236-4040 / mumbai@imsindia.com. Confirm the city centre teaches IPMAT.

faqs.question: Do CAT alumni networks help IPMAT aspirants?
faqs.answer: Only if the institute also runs IPMAT mentoring. CAT graduate networks are a different product—ask specifically for IPM alumni.

faqs.question: Are alumni ranks sponsored on CoachingCompare?
faqs.answer: No. Alumni pages reorder ranks for mentoring evidence—not sponsorship.
